hollow_greatsword.name: Hollow Greatsword
hollow_greatsword.desc: Forged from a silence. It hums when the wild is near.

abbess_cane.name: Abbess's Cane
abbess_cane.desc: Three centuries of prayers are worn into its grip.

gnarled_hide_vest.name: Gnarled Hide Vest
gnarled_hide_vest.desc: Cut from Gnarlfang's own back. It remembers being feared.

vigil_locket.name: Watch Locket
vigil_locket.desc: A watch officer's portrait, worn to nothing but a warm outline.

warders_lantern.name: The Warder's Lantern
warders_lantern.desc: Its little flame does not gutter, even underground. Especially underground.

gloam_pelt.name: Feral Pelt
gloam_pelt.desc: Fur off the empire's stock gone feral. Three centuries inside the border turned it the colour of the woods.

sprite_dust.name: Sprite Dust
sprite_dust.desc: Glitters faintly, then thinks better of it.

stag_antler.name: Elder Antler
stag_antler.desc: A shed antler of the old herds.

wight_ash.name: Wight Ash
wight_ash.desc: Ash that was never anything burned.

echo_shard.name: Echo Shard
echo_shard.desc: It repeats a bell that rang three hundred years ago.

eye_drops.name: Eye Drops
eye_drops.desc: Washes the wild from your eyes.

remedy.name: Remedy
remedy.desc: The old panacea. Cures all ailments.

drowned_katana.name: The Drowned Katana
drowned_katana.desc: Rippled steel that never fully dries.

bellbronze_mace.name: Bellbronze Mace
bellbronze_mace.desc: Cast from the bronze of the drowned valley's bell, the one that rings for nobody. It rings when swung true.

bell_toll_band.name: Bell-Toll Band
bell_toll_band.desc: Hums faintly, always at the same note.

drowned_relic.name: Drowned Relic
drowned_relic.desc: A votive from the sunken nave, worn smooth by the loch.

thorn_resin.name: Thorn Resin
thorn_resin.desc: Amber-dark sap that smells faintly of burnt honey.

root_amber.name: Root Amber
root_amber.desc: Sap turned to stone around something that still moves.

mire_pearl.name: Mire Pearl
mire_pearl.desc: A gray pearl from the fen shallows. It is always cold.

fen_shell.name: Fen Shell
fen_shell.desc: A lurker's plate, tough as boiled leather.

wisp_essence.name: Wisp Essence
wisp_essence.desc: Light that pours like water and will not fill anything.

lantern_oil_flask.name: Hot Stew
lantern_oil_flask.desc: Restores 70 HP. The inn's own, in a lidded flask. Burns warm going down.

lamproot.name: Sunroot
lamproot.desc: A pale tuber that holds a day of sunlight. Alchemists prize it; soup ruins it.

glimmer_ore.name: Glimmer Ore
glimmer_ore.desc: Ore threaded with light-bearing vein. Rings true when struck.

mere_reed.name: Mere Reed
mere_reed.desc: Hollow reed from the falling shallows. Whistles in a north wind.

ash_pearl.name: Ash Pearl
ash_pearl.desc: A pearl of pressed ash. Cold enough to remember being warm.

fox_pelt.name: Marsh-fox Pelt
fox_pelt.desc: Rust-red fur that sheds fen-water like glass.

votive_wax.name: Votive Wax
votive_wax.desc: Candle-wax from the drowned shrine. It never quite hardens.

amber_resin.name: Amber Resin
amber_resin.desc: Sun-colored sap, set hard. Something is always caught in it.

amber_shard.name: Amber Shard
amber_shard.desc: A broken pane of the wastes' glass. It hums faintly at dusk.

glass_scale.name: Glass Scale
glass_scale.desc: A drake scale gone translucent. Light passes through; heat does not.

mere_tear.name: Mere Tear
mere_tear.desc: A bead of lake water that will not dry. Cold, and heavier than water should be.

silt_chitin.name: Silt Chitin
silt_chitin.desc: Plate from a strider's back, silted through with old riverbed.

brine_pearl.name: Brine Pearl
brine_pearl.desc: A pearl grown around grief, in water that no longer exists.

cinder_ash.name: Cinder Ash
cinder_ash.desc: Ash that remembers being fire. Warm in any weather.

slag_iron.name: Slag Iron
slag_iron.desc: Forge-waste with good iron still in it, if you have the patience.

ember_glass.name: Ember Glass
ember_glass.desc: Glass from the dead forges. A spark still wanders inside it.

pale_petal.name: Pale Petal
pale_petal.desc: A flower of the King's Gardens, pale as the stags that carry it. It blooms without any light at all.

gloam_thread.name: Wild Thread
gloam_thread.desc: Silk off the Gardens' stock gone wild, three centuries past its last loom. It still takes a stitch, and holds it.

first_ash.name: First Ash
first_ash.desc: Ash from the morning of the burn, from the centre. It falls upward, slowly.

hare_pelt.name: Hare Pelt
hare_pelt.desc: Soft grey fur. Every farmhouse in the Fields has a blanket of it.

mushroom_cap.name: Mushroom Cap
mushroom_cap.desc: Cut from a cap mushnub. Edible, in the sense that it can be eaten.

slime_gel.name: Slime Gel
slime_gel.desc: Clear and faintly warm. Alchemists thicken salves with it.

forged_charter.name: Forged Charter
forged_charter.desc: A freebooter's papers: a court seal drawn by someone who has seen one once. The jackdaws on Beacon Knoll line their nests with them.

bristle_hide.name: Bristle Hide
bristle_hide.desc: The hide of Old Bristle, the boar that ran the watch farms' fences for ten years.

hen_feather.name: Hen Feather
hen_feather.desc: A wood hen's tail feather. Fletchers buy them by the hundred.

frog_leg.name: Frog Leg
frog_leg.desc: Heartwood eats these. Caerdun pretends not to.

sow_hide.name: The Orchard Sow's Hide
sow_hide.desc: The hide of the sow that ate a season of windfall a year for a decade.

frost_gel.name: Frost Gel
frost_gel.desc: Slime that never warms. Kept in a jar it will chill a room.

yeti_hide.name: The Old Man's Hide
yeti_hide.desc: White fur a hand deep. Road-Warden Tesk will want to hear about this.

pursers_ledger.name: The Purser's Ledger
pursers_ledger.desc: The grain ship's manifest, every page signed for. The last entry is dated the Night.

hound_collar.name: Hound Collar
hound_collar.desc: Imperial brass, the kennel's mark and a number. The number is in the thousands.

sentinel_plate.name: Sentinel Plate
sentinel_plate.desc: A plate from a sentinel's casing, stamped with a work order. Courts pay for these.

work_order.name: Work Order
work_order.desc: A sentinel's standing instruction, signed by the Regent. Keep the rides. Keep well.

masters_whistle.name: The Master's Whistle
masters_whistle.desc: The hound-master's whistle. Every hound in the wood still comes to it.

visitors_list.name: The Visitors' List
visitors_list.desc: Three hundred years of names, in the warden's hand. The last page is yours.

beetle_shell.name: Beetle Shell
beetle_shell.desc: A sap beetle's wing case, amber-brown and hard as a board.

foremans_saw.name: The Foreman's Saw
foremans_saw.desc: A two-man saw the Foreman carried alone. Every tooth is still sharp.

the_rota.name: The Rota
the_rota.desc: Three hundred years of shifts, every one marked absent, excused. The last line is blank.

cat_whisker.name: Cat Whisker
cat_whisker.desc: From a villa cat. The academy's alchemists want them for reasons they will not write down.

dance_card.name: Dance Card
dance_card.desc: A dance card from the sunken ballroom, filled in to the last dance. The ink has not run.

bellwethers_crown.name: Bellwether's Crown
bellwethers_crown.desc: The bony crest of the lily meres' old frog. Student Pell will want to measure it.

the_music_box.name: The Music Box
the_music_box.desc: Still mid-waltz. One bar, repeating. It will not stop and you have stopped trying.

pike_tooth.name: Pike Tooth
pike_tooth.desc: From a lake pike three centuries fat. Fishers on the Shore Road will not believe you.

striking_slip.name: Striking Slip
striking_slip.desc: A slip from the bell's record. Two numbers and a date. The second number is smaller than the first.

wardens_key.name: The Drowned Warden's Key
wardens_key.desc: An iron key to a village that is under forty feet of water.

the_striking_hammer.name: The Striking Hammer
the_striking_hammer.desc: The Bellringer's hammer. The bell will need another ringer.

silver_cutting.name: Silver Cutting
silver_cutting.desc: A cutting from the King's Gardens' silver beds. Heartwood pays for these; the gardeners count them.

gardeners_shears.name: The Gardener's Shears
gardeners_shears.desc: The Head Gardener's shears. Every hedge in the Gardens will grow out now.

nursery_ledger.name: The Nursery Ledger
nursery_ledger.desc: Phase three, for the Restoration, by order of the Regent. The first time a court reads that name.

cullet.name: Cullet
cullet.desc: Broken glass swept from the Glassworks' floors, for the melt. It cuts.

glass_pane.name: Window Pane
glass_pane.desc: A pane from the racking yard, stencilled for the capital. Phase four.

slag_lump.name: Slag Lump
slag_lump.desc: What the furnace leaves. The slag hounds eat it, somehow.

wasp_glass.name: Wasp Glass
wasp_glass.desc: A glass wasp's wing: the desert's own glass, thin as a leaf.

drake_scale_amber.name: Amber Scale
drake_scale_amber.desc: A dune drake's scale, clear as the dunes it crossed.

furnace_ledger.name: The Furnace Ledger
furnace_ledger.desc: To the capital of Vanai. Window replacements, phase four. By order of the Regent, for the Restoration. Phase four. There were three before it.

master_tongs.name: The Master's Tongs
master_tongs.desc: The Master of the Furnace's tongs, still warm. The row will bank at last.

stoker_iron.name: Stoker's Iron
stoker_iron.desc: A stoker's poker, worn to a point by three centuries of the same job.

reed_bundle.name: Reed Bundle
reed_bundle.desc: Fen reeds, cut and tied. Thatch, baskets, arrows: the Canal Works grows one crop now.

bog_iron.name: Bog Iron
bog_iron.desc: A lump of iron from the fen's mud. Moonmere's smiths take it; it smells of the canal.

leech_gland.name: Leech Gland
leech_gland.desc: From a fen leech. The alchemists want it; nobody asks what for.

fen_wolf_pelt.name: Fen Wolf Pelt
fen_wolf_pelt.desc: A reed wolf's pelt, the colour of the mist.

pike_roe.name: Pike Roe
pike_roe.desc: Roe from a canal pike. The freebooters salt it in the old lock-keepers' jars.

repair_order.name: Repair Order
repair_order.desc: Nailed to a sluice post: 'Lock the third, gates to be rehung. Navigable by the Restoration.' Dated this season.

works_ledger.name: The Works Ledger
works_ledger.desc: The sluice master's ledger of repair orders. Every lock between here and the capital, every one dated to the same season, every one 'navigable by the Restoration'.

lock_keepers_key.name: The Lock-Keeper's Key
lock_keepers_key.desc: The Lock-Keeper's key, three centuries in its ribs. The lock stair will open for the expedition's boats now.

pump_gear.name: Pump Gear
pump_gear.desc: A bronze gear from the great sluice's pumps, worn to a shine by the sentinels' hands.

wheat_sheaf.name: Wheat Sheaf
wheat_sheaf.desc: A sheaf from the reaping line, cut this morning by something that does not tire.

flour_sack.name: Flour Sack
flour_sack.desc: Milled and sacked, stencilled for the capital. Phase five.

hawk_feather.name: Hawk Feather
hawk_feather.desc: A field hawk's feather, barred gold and brown.

husk_scale.name: Husk Scale
husk_scale.desc: A husk drake's scale, the colour of ripe wheat.

ox_horn.name: Ox Horn
ox_horn.desc: A feral ox's horn. The plains' oxen went wild three centuries ago and got bigger.

provisioning_order.name: Provisioning Order
provisioning_order.desc: 'Flour for the capital, phase five. Rations for a city from the morning they arrive.' Stamped, countersigned.

provisioning_ledger.name: The Provisioning Ledger
provisioning_ledger.desc: Forty towers, filled and filling. Enough to feed their city, every man, woman and child of it, from the morning they arrive. They are not coming back to rebuild. They are coming back to resume.

reapers_blade.name: The Reaper's Blade
reapers_blade.desc: The Reaper's scythe-blade, worn to a sliver by three hundred harvests.

tally_seal.name: Tally Seal
tally_seal.desc: A tally sentinel's seal, for stamping a count. It still works. Junn wants it.

crag_feather.name: Crag Feather
crag_feather.desc: A crag hawk's feather from the wall's updraughts, grey as the stone.

snowcat_pelt.name: Snow Cat Pelt
snowcat_pelt.desc: A snow cat's pelt, white as the peaks. Caerdun's furriers pay in gold for these.

wall_stone.name: Wall Stone
wall_stone.desc: A block of the Border Wall's own masonry, ruled to the millimetre three centuries ago and unweathered.

ice_crystal.name: Ice Crystal
ice_crystal.desc: Ice from an ice slime, which does not melt. The alchemists have theories.

slate_scale.name: Slate Scale
slate_scale.desc: A scale from the Wall Drake, the colour of the rampart it hunts along.

runners_rope.name: Wall-Runner's Rope
runners_rope.desc: A wall-runner's rope for the wall's outer face. Frayed where the sentinels cut it; a gecko has nested in the coils.

wardens_seal.name: The Wall-Warden's Seal
wardens_seal.desc: The Wall-Warden's seal, for the wall's dispatches. 'Your climb was reported an hour ago.'

regents_reply.name: The Regent's Reply
regents_reply.desc: Addressed to the caretaker governments of the free cities. The household thanks you for keeping the land warm. You are asked to prepare an accounting of your stewardship, and to be ready to yield custody of the interior provinces upon the Restoration.

watch_ledger.name: Watch Ledger
watch_ledger.desc: A page of the wall's watch ledger: every climb, every hour, for three hundred years. Junn will want the lot.

ash_flower.name: Ash Flower
ash_flower.desc: A flower that grows in the ash and nowhere else, the colour of an ember. Emmer put fresh ones on the grave.

glassed_bark.name: Glassed Bark
glassed_bark.desc: Bark from a burned trunk, run to glass in the one flash. Every ripple in it points away from the city.

ember_shard.name: Ember Shard
ember_shard.desc: A shard from an ember slime, still warm three centuries on.

ash_pelt.name: Ash Beast Pelt
ash_pelt.desc: An ash beast's pelt, grey to the roots. They come at the light.

giants_tooth.name: Ash Giant's Tooth
giants_tooth.desc: A tooth from an ash giant. Nobody knows what they were before the night.

oil_flask.name: Beacon Oil
oil_flask.desc: Oil from the Beacon Fort's stores, three hundred years old and still good. The empire built to last.

emmers_letters.name: Emmer's Letters
emmers_letters.desc: Three letters from a man who waited: year one, year forty, and the last. 'It wasn't your fault either.'

beacon_log.name: The Beacon Log
beacon_log.desc: The Beacon Fort's log. The last entry, in a calm hand: 'the household departs at the appointed hour; lit at the signal; the fire faced outward, as instructed.'

keepers_lamp.name: The Beacon-Keeper's Lamp
keepers_lamp.desc: The Beacon-Keeper's lamp, the one that lit the beacon on the night.

stag_glass.name: The Glassed Stag's Antler
stag_glass.desc: An antler run to glass. The stag was in the orchard on the night; it has been running ever since.

household_key.name: Household Key
household_key.desc: A key from a household guard's ring. Every door in the city is on somebody's ring.

census_page.name: Census Page
census_page.desc: A page of the census rolls. Not theirs. Ours: Caerdun, Heartwood, Moonmere, three hundred years of births, deaths and marriages in that same calm hand.

palace_plate.name: Palace Plate
palace_plate.desc: A plate from a palace sentinel, chased with the crown. It has never been scratched.

archive_minute.name: Archive Minute
archive_minute.desc: One minute of three hundred years of minutes. Every acre, every year, noted for the crown's attention.

regents_minutes.name: The Regent's Minutes
regents_minutes.desc: The minutes of three hundred years, kept to discuss with the household. Every acre the courts hold, every year, noted.

the_last_keys.name: The Keys of the City
the_last_keys.desc: The Regent's keys. 'The door is yours; the city was always yours.'

fresh_bread.name: Fresh Bread
fresh_bread.desc: Restores 150 HP. A loaf from the capital's bakery, out warm on the morning after. The queue was chalked three hundred years ago.

mere_pearl.name: Mere Pearl
mere_pearl.desc: A pearl from the Moonmere's mussel beds, the colour of the bay at dusk. The island's jewellers set them in silver.

windfall_apple.name: Windfall Apple
windfall_apple.desc: Ground fruit from the wild orchards, never picked. A newcomer's first gift to the grove ring.

grave_goods.name: Grave-Goods
grave_goods.desc: A displaced family's grave-goods, dug up and dragged into a sett. The grudge hall wants every piece back. The families come Thursday.

book_spine.name: Burned Book Spine
book_spine.desc: A spine from the academy's burned astronomy section, drowned before the fire finished. Tables of Conjunction. Ephemeris, Years One Through...

mushroom_broth.name: Mushroom Broth
mushroom_broth.desc: Restores 45 HP. Cap mushnub, boiled until it stops arguing.

frog_legs_dish.name: Frog Legs
frog_legs_dish.desc: Restores 55 HP. Heartwood eats these. Caerdun pretends not to.

crab_stew.name: Crab Stew
crab_stew.desc: Restores 70 HP. The coach halt's own, in a lidded bowl.

apple_tart.name: Windfall Tart
apple_tart.desc: Restores 90 HP. Ground fruit only, never picked.

roe_toast.name: Roe on Toast
roe_toast.desc: Restores 160 HP. Canal pike roe, salted in the old locks, on granary bread.

harvest_loaf.name: Harvest Loaf
harvest_loaf.desc: Restores 120 HP. Baked from sheaves cut between the harvesters' rows.

calling_pld_10_head.desc: Oathbound job attire. Part of a four-piece job milestone set.

relic_caerdunfields_documents.name: Watch-Farm Muster Roll
relic_caerdunfields_documents.desc: A garrison roll from the watch farms. Every name on it answered present the night before. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_caerdunfields_goods.name: Requisitioned Sickle
relic_caerdunfields_goods.desc: The farmer's mark is filed off the tang and the empire's stamped over it. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_caerdunfields_surveys.name: Milestone Bearing Card
relic_caerdunfields_surveys.desc: Distances from milestone zero to places nobody has walked to in three hundred years. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_heartwoodfields_documents.name: Orchard Tithe Receipt
relic_heartwoodfields_documents.desc: A receipt for a tenth of a harvest. Who it was owed to has moved on, and so has the harvest. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_heartwoodfields_goods.name: Seized Grafting Knife
relic_heartwoodfields_goods.desc: Taken from a grove family. The receipt for it is in someone else's ledger. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_heartwoodfields_surveys.name: Charcoal Camp Plat
relic_heartwoodfields_surveys.desc: Each camp drawn to the yard, with the trees it may burn ticked off in red. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_moonmereshores_documents.name: Ferry Manifest Leaf
relic_moonmereshores_documents.desc: One page of a crossing's passengers. The ink stops halfway down, mid-name. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_moonmereshores_goods.name: Impounded Net Float
relic_moonmereshores_goods.desc: Glass, hand-blown, with a fishing family's mark etched round it. Impounded for an unpaid toll. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_moonmereshores_surveys.name: Causeway Sounding Sheet
relic_moonmereshores_surveys.desc: Depths along the causeway's line, taken at every tide for a year. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_northroad_documents.name: Post-House Waybill
relic_northroad_documents.desc: A courier's waybill, signed at every post-house up to the last one. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_northroad_goods.name: Commandeered Sledge Bell
relic_northroad_goods.desc: A family's sledge bell, commandeered for an army sledge that never left the yard. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_northroad_surveys.name: Snow-Pole Route Chart
relic_northroad_surveys.desc: The road as the snow poles mark it, pole by numbered pole. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_shoreroad_documents.name: Grain Ship Lading Bill
relic_shoreroad_documents.desc: Bill of lading for a hold of grain bound for a city that was empty when it should have docked. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_shoreroad_goods.name: Confiscated Pearl Comb
relic_shoreroad_goods.desc: A diver's comb, pearl set in shell, taken as surety and never given back. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_shoreroad_surveys.name: Tide-Line Survey Strip
relic_shoreroad_surveys.desc: The coast's high-water mark, walked and staked, a mile to the strip. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_huntingwood_documents.name: Royal Ride Game Book
relic_huntingwood_documents.desc: Every stag taken on the king's rides, with the day, the weather and who missed. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_huntingwood_goods.name: Forfeit Hunting Horn
relic_huntingwood_goods.desc: A forester's horn, forfeit for hunting the king's deer. His family hunted here first. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_huntingwood_surveys.name: Ride-and-Clearing Map
relic_huntingwood_surveys.desc: The wood cut into straight rides and round clearings, drawn for a king who liked a view. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_timberestates_documents.name: Overseer's Felling Order
relic_timberestates_documents.desc: An order to fell, in a hand that underlines the number twice. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_timberestates_goods.name: Seized Axe-Head
relic_timberestates_goods.desc: A grove-folk axe-head, seized when the groves became ranks. The haft was burned. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_timberestates_surveys.name: Plantation Rank Survey
relic_timberestates_surveys.desc: Trees in ranks a ruler would envy, every one numbered. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_summerlakes_documents.name: Villa Guest Register Page
relic_summerlakes_documents.desc: A page of a summer villa's guest book. The last party never signed out. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_summerlakes_goods.name: Requisitioned Boat Lantern
relic_summerlakes_goods.desc: A lake family's lantern, taken for the villas' regatta and never returned. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_summerlakes_surveys.name: Lake Depth Chart
relic_summerlakes_surveys.desc: Soundings for a lake dug deeper to suit a view. The village it drowned is marked in pencil. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_reservoir_documents.name: Drowned Parish Register
relic_reservoir_documents.desc: The valley's births and marriages, up to the day the water was let in. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_reservoir_goods.name: Drowned Valley Hearth Key
relic_reservoir_goods.desc: Its house is under forty feet of water. The empire kept the key. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_reservoir_surveys.name: Dam Footing Survey
relic_reservoir_surveys.desc: Where the dam would stand, and a careful line showing where the water would come to. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_kingsgardens_documents.name: Gardener's Planting Ledger
relic_kingsgardens_documents.desc: What was planted, where and when; the last entries are this spring's, in a sentinel's hand. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_kingsgardens_goods.name: Grove Cutting Label
relic_kingsgardens_goods.desc: A nursery label naming the grove this cutting was taken from. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_kingsgardens_surveys.name: Parterre Layout Sheet
relic_kingsgardens_surveys.desc: The garden beds drawn to the inch, with a note on which hedge must never be cut. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_glassworks_documents.name: Furnace Tally Slip
relic_glassworks_documents.desc: A count of panes crated for the capital. The furnaces have kept counting. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_glassworks_goods.name: Seized Glassblower's Pipe
relic_glassworks_goods.desc: A blowing pipe, seized with the workshop it belonged to. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_glassworks_surveys.name: Kiln-Line Survey
relic_glassworks_surveys.desc: The line of the furnaces across the sand, drawn by someone who measured the heat too. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_canalworks_documents.name: Lock-Keeper's Log Leaf
relic_canalworks_documents.desc: A lock-keeper's log: barges up, barges down, and one line written very small. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_canalworks_goods.name: Impounded Eel Trap
relic_canalworks_goods.desc: A fen family's eel trap, impounded when the fen was drained for the cut. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_canalworks_surveys.name: Fen Drainage Plan
relic_canalworks_surveys.desc: Every ditch and sluice of a fen that would not stay drained. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_granaryplains_documents.name: Granary Store Docket
relic_granaryplains_documents.desc: A store docket, filled to the last sack for a homecoming. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_granaryplains_goods.name: Requisitioned Threshing Flail
relic_granaryplains_goods.desc: A farm's flail, requisitioned for the imperial floors with the harvest it threshed. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_granaryplains_surveys.name: Field Boundary Plat
relic_granaryplains_surveys.desc: Fields squared off by a ruler, the old hedges marked for grubbing out. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_borderwall_documents.name: Embassy Dispatch Fragment
relic_borderwall_documents.desc: Part of a dispatch from the embassy on the wall. The rest was burned unread. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_borderwall_goods.name: Seized Pedlar's Scales
relic_borderwall_goods.desc: A pedlar's scales, seized at the gate for weighing short. They weigh true. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_borderwall_surveys.name: Rampart Road Itinerary
relic_borderwall_surveys.desc: The wall's road tower by tower, with the distance and the climb between. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

relic_burnedland_documents.name: Scorched Census Page
relic_burnedland_documents.desc: A census page, scorched at one edge, counting a household that was not there to count. Moonmere's court pays to read it.

relic_burnedland_goods.name: Fire-Blackened Keepsake
relic_burnedland_goods.desc: Something a family kept, blackened in a fire that ran the wrong way. Heartwood's court pays to have it back.

relic_burnedland_surveys.name: Fire-Line Sketch Map
relic_burnedland_surveys.desc: The one border no surveyor drew. Somebody tried. Caerdun's court pays to enter it in the record.

named_relic.name: A Named Relic
named_relic.desc: Bound to its finder. Register it at your own court's registry before it crumbles.

snare_silk.name: Snare Silk
snare_silk.desc: A snow spider's line, cut off a coach wheel on the North Road pass. It looks like nothing and holds a mule.
